description: Defines synchronization primitives 'sync_event' and 'scoped_sync_token' for thread coordination, including wait and token management functionalities.

classes.name: sync_event
classes.description: A synchronization primitive similar to a barrier, allowing threads to wait until all tokens are reset.

classes.name: scoped_sync_token
classes.description: A RAII token that notifies its associated sync_event upon destruction or reset.

methods.name: sync_event::get_token
methods.description: Creates and returns a new scoped_sync_token associated with the sync_event.

methods.name: sync_event::wait
methods.description: Blocks until all tokens are reset, ensuring synchronization.

methods.name: scoped_sync_token::reset
methods.description: Resets the token, potentially unlocking the sync_event.

methods.name: scoped_sync_token::swap
methods.description: Swaps the internal token pointers between two scoped_sync_token instances.
